snippet.title: Need for Speed Hot Pursuit - Autolog Explained
snippet.description:
Connect, compare and compete...

Criterion Games producer, Matt Webster, explains exactly how Autolog will work within Need for Speed Hot Pursuit. In this video he discusses what players can do on their walls and how Autolog will personalize your experience through updates and recommendations based on your and your friends' gameplay!

Pre-order the Limited Edition of the game and get exclusive access to TWO amazing cars, as well as immediate access to FOUR locked vehicles right out of the box.

*Pre-Order Need for Speed Hot Pursuit*
http://bit.ly/dgVvQy

*More Info*
http://hotpursuit.needforspeed.com

*Blog*
http://hotpursuit.needforspeed.com/blog
